transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, our central chilled-water pump P-2 failed during the morning shift, and the affected production areas are currently without their normal cooling capacity. We need to figure out how to restore cooling to the areas that need it today. I understand the reactor suite has a scheduled batch, and the packaging area and utilities workshop also use chilled water. Before we consider any temporary hose connections, we'll need to go through our standard pre-work review covering process, maintenance, and environmental health and safety findings. Let's hear from each of you what your area's situation and needs are so we can put together a cooling plan.

I'll make sure that gets done as part of the pre-work review documentation. These are the EHS findings we need factored into the cooling plan.
